note: Inputs of lm/build.py, each checked by sha256 before use. Nothing here is committed or redistributed except as the built LM (a release asset, CC BY-SA 4.0 with the attributions below). $HERD is the fleet's shared box (/local/home/skerraut/herd-vita-ocr). The corpora are synth3's text pools (synth/synth3_text.py, data/manifests/synth3_text_sources.json: norm_vn display form, pieces of at most 60 characters, every character in data/vocab.txt), built from the pinned raw sources listed there.

aozora_dialogue.licence: public-domain texts (Aozora Bunko); dataset CC BY 4.0
aozora_dialogue.attribution: Aozora Bunko (https://www.aozora.gr.jp/), via globis-university/aozorabunko-clean (https://huggingface.co/datasets/globis-university/aozorabunko-clean, CC BY 4.0)

aozora_narration.licence: public-domain texts (Aozora Bunko); dataset CC BY 4.0
aozora_narration.attribution: Aozora Bunko (https://www.aozora.gr.jp/), via globis-university/aozorabunko-clean (https://huggingface.co/datasets/globis-university/aozorabunko-clean, CC BY 4.0)

jesc.attribution: JESC: Japanese-English Subtitle Corpus, Pryzant et al. 2018 (https://nlp.stanford.edu/projects/jesc/, CC BY-SA 4.0)

wiki.attribution: Japanese Wikipedia via wikimedia/wikipedia 20231101.ja (https://huggingface.co/datasets/wikimedia/wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0)

vn.attribution: Jiten visual-novel frequency list (https://jiten.moe/frequency-dictionaries, 2,162 VN scripts; CC BY-SA 4.0); retrieved 2026-10-12 and again 2026-10-14 with the same bytes

novel.attribution: Jiten novel frequency list (https://jiten.moe/frequency-dictionaries, 3,161 novels; CC BY-SA 4.0); retrieved 2026-10-14

realplus.use: held-out VN text for the pruning-profile choice only (never trained on): the realplus v2 labels, training-side VNs of the recognizer's pool; no development or protected set

vndb_chars.note: VNDB character names by VN, from the VNDB dump of 2026-10-12 (ODbL 1.0 / DbCL 1.0; synth3 text/README_vndb.md)

vndb_titles.note: VNDB titles by VN, the same dump
